{{Quote|Charger!|Fives to Charger as he fell|<ref name="TC">{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}}</ref>}}

'''Charger''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served under [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Charger was part of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] led team sent to rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who was being held captive in a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] called the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], a highly secured prison known for no escapes that was run by the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] known as [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. Charger was free-climbing with the rest of the team to the top of the Citadel and was one of the last to reach the top after [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] deactivated the [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] door. Fellow [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] trooper [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] tried to help him up, but before Charger could grab Fives' hand, he lost his footing by a loose rock, then slipped and free-fell down toward an [[Electro-mine/Legends|electro-mine]], which electrocuted him to death and sounded an alarm within the Citadel, thus making the mission more difficult for the rest of the group.

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] Charger stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meters]].

==Equipment==
Charger utilized white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], and a [[Backpack/Legends|Backpack]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the episode, Charger was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] through the series.
